title: GearItem
description: PROVISIONAL. Gear is the revenue layer and gets its own phase. This schema exists so Phase 0 locks the shape of the file, not so gear can be built now. Expect it to change before any gear page ships.

x-notes.provisional: Unlike the venue, city, county and state schemas, this one is NOT locked by decisions.md. It is a placeholder for the gear phase.
x-notes.provenance_applies: Rule 7 binds gear too. A price, a weight or a spec is a published fact and needs a source_url and a date_checked. Prices move faster than court data, so the gear cadence will be shorter than the venue cadence.
x-notes.disclosure: Affiliate links carry a disclosure obligation. Where and how that renders is an OPEN decision, O7.

category.description: Maps to the {category} segment of /pickleball-gear/{category}/. Needs a controlled vocabulary before any gear page ships.

specs.description: Free-form spec bag for now. Becomes typed when the gear phase starts.
